dispositions.PR_CRITICAL: Runs on every Web pull request and in the full regression.
dispositions.FULL_REGRESSION: Runs in the full regression after merge/manual execution, not every Web pull request.
dispositions.LOWER_LEVEL: Still runs in the full regression until equivalent lower-level coverage is committed and the browser case can be removed.

comments-delete-ownership.spec.ts.reason: Comment deletion must retain resource admission through return, prevent immediate duplicate DELETEs and preserve content on failure until deliberate retry.

comments-create-ownership.spec.ts.reason: Shared Story replies must admit one POST through immediate duplicate events and return, preserve new drafts and replace a stale initial read after confirmed creation.

comments-edit-ownership.spec.ts.reason: Comment editing must preserve later drafts, correct If-Match retries and separate task feedback across all three Story consumers.

comments-offline-writes.spec.ts.reason: Production create/edit/delete must reject offline intent, preserve input and require deliberate retry instead of reconnect replay across all three Story comment consumers.

floating-bottom-nav-scroll.spec.ts.reason: Persistent navigation clearance, bounded account/Space-scoped primary context, browser history/native tab replacement and native touch swipe ownership.

heart-moment-delete-ownership.spec.ts.reason: Shared/private destructive intent, interruption ownership, competing privacy writes and offline no-replay must remain protected in the production browser.

memory-diary-storage.spec.ts.reason: Real IndexedDB/File upgrade, scoped payload reads, metadata-only expiry/logout and rejected late-open connection ownership.

private-token-contrast.spec.ts.reason: The contract is an axe scan against the rendered private-state route, not a static token-only invariant.

product-gutters.spec.ts.reason: Real CSS layout/container-query coverage remains browser-native; Phase B consolidates the full breakpoint matrix into four tests without dropping any checked width.

product-reflow.spec.ts.reason: WCAG reflow and clipped-control checks depend on real rendered geometry across routed product surfaces and remain browser-native.

r2-momente-timeline-evidence.spec.ts.reason: Phase B keeps unique R2 behavior (month ordering, explicit order change, filtered Back restoration, Search return/deep-link behavior, reduced motion) and removes only presentation cases covered more strongly elsewhere.

theme-forced-colors.spec.ts.reason: Forced-colors behavior depends on Chromium media emulation and computed styles and remains browser-native.

today-living-home.spec.ts.reason: PO #1546 removes retrospective/monthly surfaces. Retire overlapping carousel/caption cases for the removed component; preserve whole-page hierarchy, source uniqueness/navigation, keyboard, motion, theme, 320px/200% reflow and accessibility checks, with explicit recap absence for one/two/three-photo source sets.

perspective-game.spec.ts.reason: Concealed two-person handoff, first input, neutral reveal, restart and local-session return must remain protected in the production browser.

milestone-delete-ownership.spec.ts.reason: Explicit destructive intent, pending return, offline no-replay and task-owned completion must remain protected in the production browser.

session-retention.spec.ts.reason: Real App restoration must retain credentials across temporary outages, refresh on reconnect and clear definitive rejection without requiring repeated login.

photo-places.spec.ts.reason: Default-on account consent, saved shared-photo context, explicit map navigation, deliberate unlink and Compact/Expanded Light/Dark accessibility.

relationship-reflections.spec.ts.reason: Special Plan confirmed highlight, Today duplicate suppression and return; Pro passport capability and canonical shared content access across Compact Light/Dark and Expanded.

wir-design-selection.spec.ts.reason: Wir design selection and retention, quote/statistics order persistence with direct pointer tracking, and concise notification/private/profile settings across Compact/Expanded themes and large text.

moment-relation-picker.spec.ts.reason: Places and Chapters share one content-recognition picker; selection, type-filter continuity, real save/detail/return, privacy-safe search, large text, focus and cancellation must remain coherent.

mobile-header-more.spec.ts.reason: Headerless Compact navigation, More utility discovery, authoritative unread status, safe areas, sign-out and capability gating.

plan-cover-layout.spec.ts.reason: Complete portrait/landscape/square Plan images, original-versus-thumbnail reads, sensitive concealment and staged edit/cancel/return across actual overview/detail routes, Compact/Expanded and large text.

product-consistency.spec.ts.reason: The PO-approved combined Moments composition must preserve manual Place linking, modal return, icon/rail alignment, theme, Compact/Expanded and large-text reflow.

shared-wish-selection.spec.ts.reason: Explicit private favorites, authorized shared/zero-match/solo results, canonical Plan conversion and return, offline no-replay and Compact/Expanded theme/reflow acceptance for #1535.

automatic-recaps.spec.ts.reason: Automatic month/year discovery, focused source-return reader, selection conflict safety, private draft/share/save/withdraw and retained Free reads across Compact/Expanded themes.

places-and-lists-design.spec.ts.reason: Places and Lists create/result/return, dirty modal boundaries, read-first entry editing, failed-save recovery, checking, sorting, removal and theme/reflow acceptance.

memory-map-and-couple-games.spec.ts.reason: Protects saved-memory map privacy/Pro admission/source return, finite playable games, explicit tile consent and calendar date semantics.
